sections.content: Use si + imperfect subjunctive and the conditional to describe what would happen under an imagined condition.

items.spanish: Si cambiara el plan, ocurriría algo diferente.
items.english: If the plan changed, something different would happen.
If it rained, we would not go out.

items.spanish: Si siguiera por el camino principal, llegaría a un lugar desconocido.
items.english: If she kept to the main road, she would arrive at an unknown place.

sections.content: Don't confuse this with a simple real condition like Si *llueve*, no *salimos* (present + present, a routine fact) — Si *lloviera*, no *saldríamos* presents the rain as unlikely or purely imagined.
